title: Fixed an issue where `merge()` called inside `batch()` after a column move, a row move, or a sort merged the wrong cells. In that case, `merge()` and `unmerge()` now take effect when the batch ends. Also fixed a merge made before a column move in a batch that did not follow the column, and the undo of a batch that holds a reorder and a merge, which left the merge in place.
